about: 10th Anniversary brings refined visuals, completely redesigned and revised sections to all of the content that launched in both the original release, and 2014’s Q.U.B.E: Director's Cut - which itself added a completely new story by award-winning…

Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary also includes new content, including an entirely brand new chapter called Sector 8, featuring an additional 4-6 hours of gameplay unlocked after the main campaign has been completed.
Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary is set to serve as the ultimate celebration of Q.U.B.E.’s ten-year run.
summary: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary is the definitive edition of the original Q.U.B.E.
